Title: Full UI Lifecycle Automation
Kind: Operator console over the DB-M12.2 hardened backend (temporary DevBridge scaffolding; nothing migrates into Nexus)
Summary: The DevBridge operator console is the complete operator surface over the DB-M12.2 backend: it launches; it shows an unmissable TRIAL vs REAL mode banner (no silent/automatic mode switch); it renders the 12-stage / 8-token lifecycle from backend state (never invented by the UI); the next-action panel and enabled button set are backend-driven (NextActionEngine); M03-M11 commands are callable and correctly gated (M05 zero-context handoff gate, M06-fail blocks M07, trial safe-stop, real human Git gates with no automatic merge, M10 trial NOT_APPLICABLE / real merge prerequisite, M11 advisory read-only); writer-busy, stale-state and backend-mismatch are surfaced; history never hides failed attempts; the parallel view never guesses a repository; there is no roadmap structural-edit capability, no auto baseline restore, no silent mode switch; DB-M26 stays a separate read-only analytics module that renders its own recorded result; and nothing touches the workbook, Nexus source, or current trial evidence. Recovered from an interrupted session (API connection lost): all prior valid writes preserved; only the missing deltas were finished.

UISurface.HistoryView: TaskHistoryService rows; failed attempts never hidden

DefectsFoundAndFixed: MainViewModel.Refresh: buttons + clipboard status were computed while the busy flag was still true (reset only at the end of Refresh), leaving every lifecycle button permanently disabled and the operator console inoperable. Fixed by arming buttons/clipboard after IsBusy is cleared and visually disabling all buttons while a governed command runs (RunOperatorCommand).
